title: Zorbalık 2
author: Rıfat Batur
description: Bullying can sometimes be hidden in a glance, sometimes in a word, and sometimes in a silent joke. So how does a bully emerge? What goes on in a child's mind? And most importantly... Is it possible to avoid becoming a bully, to deal with a bully? To find the answers to these questions, we embark on a journey into Okan's mind. Navigating between Uncle Vural's combative attitude, Aunt Pohpoh's sweet but dangerous words, and Nünü's selfishness, we will discover step by step how a bully actually “emerges.” Because anyone can be a bully. But anyone can also be good.
